note.zh-TW: 現金流量表模板的「銷貨債權」直譯自日文，指的就是這個科目；IAS 1 的報表大項名稱是 trade and other receivables。
note.en: The template cash flow line uses a Japanese-style name (literally "sales credits") for the same account; the IAS 1 line item is trade and other receivables.

definition.zh-TW: 賒銷之後客戶還沒付的貨款。它是流動資產，收到錢時減少；賒銷當下收入已經認列，所以應收帳款增加表示有收入還沒變成現金。
definition.en: Amounts customers still owe for goods sold on credit. It is a current asset that falls when the customer pays; revenue is recognised at the sale, so a rise in receivables means some revenue has not yet turned into cash.
